phrase.zh: 帷幕之外，也有自己的舞台。
phrase.en: Beyond the curtain, find a stage of your own.

visual.zh: 为《百老汇旋律》独立创作的舞台拼贴，以早期麦克风、钢琴、踢踏舞鞋和装饰艺术风格的舞台框架，表现音乐片的声音与演出。
visual.en: An original theatrical collage for The Broadway Melody, combining an early microphone, piano, tap shoes and an Art Deco proscenium to evoke sound and performance.

background.zh:
《百老汇旋律》是一部1929年的早期有声音乐片，讲述两姐妹从家乡来到百老汇寻求演出机会。画面用音乐与舞台物件表达她们的表演梦想；是艺术解读，不重现具体镜头，也不是原版海报。
第2届奥斯卡最佳影片：百老汇旋律。颁奖年份 1930；参评年份 1928/29。
background.en:
The Broadway Melody is an early sound musical from 1929 about two sisters who leave their hometown to seek success on Broadway. Music and stage objects interpret their performing ambitions; the image does not recreate a specific shot or original poster.
Academy Awards ceremony 2 (1930), Best Picture: The Broadway Melody. Eligibility year: 1928/29.
